unsupported.body: Stripe cannot enable card payments here. Get in touch and we will fix it with you.

keyMismatch.fix: Both keys must be set for the same environment, and the site rebuilt afterward — the publishable key is baked in at build time, the secret key is read on every request.

walkUp.body: How you take money at the window. HatchGrab charges no platform fee on walk-ups, whichever you choose.
walkUp.ownTerminalHelp: Square, Clover, or whatever you already use. Nothing to set up — only your provider’s own fees apply.
walkUp.hatchgrabHelp: Uses the same Stripe connection as your online payments — a card reader, or tap to pay straight from your phone or tablet.
walkUp.hatchgrabFees: {fee} per payment on {region}, plus {surcharge} for tap to pay on a phone or tablet. Other cards may cost more.
